note: Thirst (Dave 2026-10-21): hydration holds up to thirst.cap_ml; it falls rest_ml_day plus work_ml_day x exertion a game day, so a full body lasts at least one game day even at full exertion and needs one drink a day. A mouthful at the water edge gives drink_ml (the server checks water within reach_m of the feet); drink items give ml from the drink table. Empty thirst stops health recovering; nothing else yet. Hunger, health and body weight as an energy balance (Dave 2026-10-20). A stomach holds up to stomach_cap_kcal; the body burns rest_kcal_per_kg_day x weight a day plus work_kcal_day x exertion (0 to 1, from how fast the player moves and tool work). A full stomach lasts at least one game day (24 game hours = 1 real hour at the 24:1 clock) at ordinary activity. When the stomach is empty the shortfall is burnt from the body: weight falls kcal/kcal_per_kg. Eating beyond a full stomach (up to overeat_allowance) turns the surplus into weight at gain_efficiency. Health recovers slowly while the stomach is not empty. Nothing here can kill. food = kcal per item: by_id wins over by_suffix (an item id that ends with the word). Plants whose flora uses include poison give nothing. Limp (build 513, protocol 58): a crippling injury (wolves) slows the player to speed_share of normal for `seconds` real seconds, or until health is back to heal_at of the maximum.

breath.note: Dave 2026-10-21: an oxygen symbol with a countdown (seconds) shows only with the head under water; the air lasts seconds at ordinary swimming pace, runs down rest_mult as fast resting or floating still (up to rest_speed m/s), hard_mult as fast swimming hard (from hard_speed m/s), and is full again the instant the head is above the surface. BUG-029 (Dave 2026-11-04): at zero air the player stays under water (no auto-rise): for faint_after_s seconds suffocation races the heart from bpm.start to bpm.peak and closes the vision, then the character faints (unconscious). Fainting with the head still under water is drowning: the character dies (can_die, death.json). Surfacing before then clears it. The exertion collapse (exertion.json) never kills; this is a separate path.

sources.note: Drinking water from the record (docs/design/drinking_water_design.md; Sonny springs_and_drinking_water.md). On since Dave's 8 Nov ruling (OVERNIGHT_DECISIONS row 26); off, today's drink anywhere near water. On, with the scene's water_source rows: springs run always (unless their drought flow is 0 in summer), brooks by regime (2 dry in summer unless it rained within rain_memory_h game hours; 3 only within flash_memory_h of rain), salt water (ocean, estuary) is refused, frozen water needs an ice hole. A brook below a spring stays open open_m x sqrt(L/s) x cold_x below it (Jamie #739), halved from breeze_wind, and asks for a hole past that only where the ice bears (_on_ice). No sickness: one kind of water (sickness.json, Dave 21 Oct).
sources.say_salt: Salt water. It would only make you thirstier.
sources.say_frozen: The water is frozen. Break a hole in the ice first.
